## Build an environment
1. Create a project environment shell script that:
    - Prints the name of the project to STDOUT
    - Loads, activates, and configures the FreeSurfer module
    - Adds a project directory to your path
    - Sets global variables
    - Activates the conda environment from the previous [lesson](../10-conda/10-practice.qmd)
1. Share evidence of the environment script working with your instructor
